title: Simple internal processing: customer-support ticket log (artificial, Low tier)

source.reason: Identified processing as its permanent state (PGF-18 Part A §3.1 archetype 4); default weight vector (PGF-18 Part A §4.1)

g_l.basis: Lawful basis recorded (handling the customer's own request); Art. 13 notice at collection; purpose unchanged; no Art. 9 or Art. 10 data; no Art. 22 decision; no transfer outside the EEA

source.reason: Artificial G-L record for a teaching case

g_dpia.basis: No statutory trigger, no supervisory-authority list entry, none of the nine WP248 rev.01 criteria met; triage record kept with DPO advice on the triage

g_36.reason: G-36 is evaluated for every DPIA; no DPIA exists for this processing

scenarios.description: Loss of confidentiality: a support agent, or someone using an agent's credentials, copies the ticket log and it is disclosed or misused (e.g. targeted phishing quoting real orders)

source.reason: Scenario defined for the teaching case

evidence.l1: 12 named agents use the log every working day (routine access)
evidence.l2: Vetted staff; no motivated or capable attacker identified (documented assumption)
evidence.l3_residual: Role-based access control, bulk export disabled, monthly access-log review: implemented and tested (artificial evidence ref EVP-ART-0001)
evidence.l4: Insider misuse of similar support data reported in the sector; no event in the organisation's own processing in the last 24 months

source.reason: Scores assigned on the artificial evidence above against the PGF-18 Part A §3.2 anchors

Structured fields only (name, e-mail, order number, product, issue category, status); ~2,500 customers a year; one ticketing system in the organisation's own environment; direct collection with clear notice

scenarios.description: Loss of control: ticket data drift into a use the customer was not told about (e.g. targeting marketing campaigns)

source.reason: Scenario defined for the teaching case

evidence.l1: Extracts for other purposes are occasional (periodic), restricted to named roles
evidence.l2: Unintended drift of use; no motivated party identified
evidence.l3_residual: Extract-approval workflow and purpose restriction implemented, partially tested (artificial evidence ref EVP-ART-0002)

source.reason: Scores assigned on the artificial evidence above against the PGF-18 Part A §3.2 anchors
